Corollary
[Pushforwards of Lie Brackets]

↗ prop:8-30

1. ch8:8.31If $F\colon M\to N$ is a diffeomorphism and $X_1,X_2\in \mathfrak {X}(M)$, then \[ F_*[X_1,X_2]=[F_*X_1,F_*X_2]. \]

Proof

\sketch Apply Proposition 6 with $Y_i=F_*X_i$ and use the uniqueness of the pushforward.

□
